title: Enable verified workspace search Skill
goal: Make workspace content search a real, scoped Skill in the default Agent and verify it end-to-end through the canonical M8 loop.
context: SkillRuntime already contains an allowlisted workspace.search adapter and WorkspaceReadTool implements bounded, secret-filtered search, but FileSkillStore does not install a workspace.search manifest and the default Agent does not include it. Existing workspaceToolsEnabled guards only block workspace.create-file, so adding search without updating every guard could expose workspace access when disabled. The adapter also currently forwards the whole natural-language request as the search query.
forbidden_changes: Do not broaden workspace read/write roots, protected-file rules, or secret filtering.
Do not bypass ModuleRuntime policy, Agent scope, executor schema binding, or verification.
Do not migrate or overwrite user-edited Agent manifests; migrate only the exact previous built-in default.
Do not change unrelated UI, provider, storage, or terminal behavior.
acceptance_criteria: FileSkillStore installs a valid workspace.search Skill bound only to tool.workspace.read and the allowlisted workspace.search adapter.
The built-in default Agent includes workspace.search while preserving any user-edited Agent scope.
When workspace tools are disabled, neither workspace.search nor workspace.create-file can be selected or executed by the canonical chat/team Skill routes.
Vietnamese and English search requests extract a bounded non-empty query and return actual matching workspace paths through ModuleRuntime.
End-to-end search does not expose secret-like file contents or paths and returns a verified empty result when no files match.
Integration tests prove a real search result is verified and disabled workspace search returns no result without reading workspace content.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If integration tests fail, inspect the exact manifest installation, default Agent migration, natural-language query adapter, and workspaceToolsEnabled scope filters; keep the repair within the declared files and rerun all required gates.
